for: quests/build.py multi-source loader (BAYOU): world smiles:<zone>, zones are smiles/registry/smiles.json zones[].id
note: AUTHORED tooth-fairy style eggs in the AUTHORED Unspoken Smiles district. Play only: never a completion record.

entries.title: The tooth fairy dropped a coin
entries.hint: Where do tired walkers rest by the river?
entries.reveal: Baby teeth hold space for adult teeth, so caring for them matters too (public-health dental guidance).

entries.title: The golden toothbrush
entries.hint: Two minutes, twice a day - find the brush that shines at school.
entries.reveal: Brushing twice a day for two minutes with fluoride toothpaste is the everyday habit public-health dental guidance recommends.

entries.title: A lost baby molar
entries.hint: Something small and white is buried where kids dig.
entries.reveal: Back teeth have grooves where food can hide; dental sealants are one way clinics help protect them (public-health dental guidance).

entries.title: The floss rainbow
entries.hint: Between the teeth and between the walls - look for a thread of colour.
entries.reveal: Cleaning between your teeth every day reaches places a toothbrush misses (public-health dental guidance).

entries.title: The van's secret sticker
entries.hint: The clinic on wheels hides a smile sticker.
entries.reveal: Mobile dental vans and school programmes bring check-ups to where people already are (public-health dental programmes, in general terms).

entries.title: The sugar bug poster
entries.hint: A sneaky bug loves sticky sweets - find its poster in the shop.
entries.reveal: Mouth germs feed on sugar and make acids that can harm tooth enamel, so limit sugary snacks and drinks (public-health dental guidance).

entries.title: The giant model molar
entries.hint: The lab bench keeps a tooth far too big for any mouth.
entries.reveal: Dental labs make crowns, dentures and models from impressions or digital scans - one of many dental careers.

entries.title: The crunchy carrot
entries.hint: A crunchy snack grows in the ground near the van lot.
entries.reveal: Crunchy vegetables, cheese and water are tooth-friendly snack choices (general public-health nutrition guidance).

entries.title: The picture book about teeth
entries.hint: A quiet place with many stories hides one about smiles.
entries.reveal: Picture books about brushing and check-ups are a friendly way for families to talk about healthy habits (public-health dental guidance).

entries.title: The team water bottle
entries.hint: Thirsty after the match? Look by the bench.
entries.reveal: Water is a great drink after sport; many sports drinks have added sugar (public-health dental guidance).

entries.title: The lost mouthguard
entries.hint: Players protect their smiles near the goal.
entries.reveal: A mouthguard helps protect teeth during contact sports (public-health dental guidance).

entries.title: The check-up reminder card
entries.hint: Wait for the bus and read the reminder.
entries.reveal: Regular dental check-ups are part of public-health dental guidance - plan how you will get there.

entries.title: The crunchy apple
entries.hint: A market stall keeps a crunchy, tooth-friendly snack.
entries.reveal: Whole fruit and vegetables make tooth-friendly snacks (general public-health nutrition guidance).

entries.title: The bubbly soap bar
entries.hint: Someone left soap by a porch on Maple Row.
entries.reveal: Wash hands with soap and water, scrubbing all over, before eating and after the toilet (public-health hand hygiene guidance).

entries.title: The old frayed toothbrush
entries.hint: A worn-out brush waits in a Birch Row garden.
entries.reveal: Replace a toothbrush when its bristles look frayed or worn (public-health dental guidance).

entries.title: The kitchen tap
entries.hint: Clean water flows in a Cedar Row kitchen.
entries.reveal: Many communities add fluoride to drinking water to help prevent tooth decay (public-health dental guidance).
